name: 17602 · Lancaster, PA
findings: ZIP 17602 (Lancaster) has 194 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17602 (Lancaster) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17602 (Lancaster) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
